get.description: Authenticate with the Bearer access token. Aayulogic administration: global permissions only; X-Organization-ID is ignored. Responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Requires partners.partner.view. The verification review queue and partner directory. Filter by status (pending, verified, rejected) and intake_path (self_service, assisted); search matches business or organization name (case-insensitive substring). Offset pagination: limit (default 20), offset (default 0). Ordered by business name then UUID.

post.description: Authenticate with the Bearer access token. Aayulogic administration: global permissions only; X-Organization-ID is ignored. Responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Requires partners.partner.create. Registers an existing organization as a partner with intake_path=assisted and status=pending, recording you as the registrant; it follows exactly the same rules as self-service. Each organization can be a partner once (409 otherwise). State and audit commit together. Omitted optional profile fields are stored empty. Verification is one of three independent publishing gates: it never publishes content, records payment or grants commercial eligibility.
